Messages.Author: PDB6
Messages.Body:
Patrick wrote:
"I recently picked up a couple a boxes of V:tes at a yard sale. I was
wondering if there was a card limit that one can have per deck. (Magic
limit of 4, RAGE limit of 3 sept, 2 combat)"

Nope. No card limit whatsoever. You need to have a minimum of 12 vampires in
your crypt and a minimum of 40 cards in your deck (there is a deck size
_maximum_ based on the number of players, but that is in the rules. Tourney
rules dictate a maximim deck size of 90 cards). If you want all 12 of your
vampires to be Sammy and all 40 of the card in your deck to be Assault Rifles,
you are perfectly welcome to.

Some folks like to use card limits in Jyhad for various reasons, but it is in
no way needed (in fact it tends to compromise game balance) and the official
rules (normal games and tournament rules) call for no card limits.
